A fellow religious student, (a pupil
 of the same preceptor); {#yamAtmanaH satIrTyaM pitEva te jAnIte yo'sO yAdfSaSceti#}
 <ls>Māl. 2</ls>. According to <ls>Pāṇini (VI. 3. 87)</ls>

 the latter word alone is correct. {#SabdaratnAvalI#}, however, says, {#“syAt#}
 {#satIrTaH satIrTyo'pi taTEkagururityapi#}.{#”#} Bohtlingk and Wackernagel
 say that the word {#satIrTa#} is approved to be correct by Vopadeva. But
 this is wrong because {#mugDaboDavyAkaraRa#} accepts {#satIrTya#} alone to be correct.
